How does Linkable work?

Connect your Shopify store, choose a product and launch a campaign. Set your goals and decide whether to offer a gift, a fixed fee, affiliate commission or a combination. Creators can apply to your campaign, or you can discover and invite them directly. Once you accept a creator, manage the collaboration, receive content or promotion, and track your results in one place.

How do I find creators for my brand?

You can receive applications from creators interested in your campaign, browse the Linkable marketplace, or invite creators you already know. Review their profiles, content and audience insights to find the right fit, then choose who you want to work with.

What will I receive from a collaboration?

You decide what you want creators to deliver. This can include photos, videos, testimonials, published social media content, or a combination of content and promotion. Your campaign requirements make expectations clear before creators apply, and you can manage submissions and track activity through Linkable.

How are creators compensated?

You can offer creators a free product, a fixed fee, affiliate commission, or combine these incentives. Gifted collaborations involve sending the agreed product, while fixed fees are agreed and paid directly between you and the creator. Affiliate commissions are tracked and managed through Linkable, with payouts processed after the applicable returns window.

How much does Linkable cost?

Linkable offers subscription plans designed for ecommerce brands at different stages of creator marketing. Pricing depends on the plan and features you choose. Visit our pricing page to see the latest plans, limits and any applicable fees.

Does Linkable guarantee sales?

No. Creator marketing can generate content, introduce your brand to new audiences and drive sales, but results depend on factors such as your product, offer, creators and campaign strategy. Linkable provides the tools to manage collaborations and measure their impact, but we do not guarantee a specific number of sales or return on investment.

Do I need to ship product to creators?

If your campaign includes a gifted product, you are responsible for sending it to the creators you accept. You can also run paid or affiliate collaborations depending on your goals and the agreement with each creator. Shipping requirements should be made clear in your campaign so creators know what to expect.

How long until I see results?

Timelines vary depending on your campaign, the creators you work with and what you want to achieve. You may begin receiving applications shortly after launching, while content delivery and promotion depend on product shipping and the agreed collaboration timeline. Sales and longer-term brand growth can take more time, so we recommend evaluating campaigns across content, reach, engagement and sales where relevant.

What happens if a creator doesn't deliver?

If a creator is delayed or unable to complete a collaboration, you can contact them through Linkable and review the agreed requirements. We recommend setting clear deliverables and timelines before accepting creators. If an issue cannot be resolved, our support team can help review the situation, although Linkable cannot guarantee that every creator will complete a collaboration.

Is Linkable only available for Shopify brands?

Yes. Linkable is currently built for Shopify ecommerce brands. Its native integration lets you connect your store, select products, launch campaigns and track affiliate activity without relying on separate ecommerce tracking tools.

How is Linkable different from other influencer platforms?

Linkable brings creator discovery, gifted and paid collaborations, content management, promotion and native Shopify affiliate tracking into one platform. Rather than focusing only on influencer discovery or affiliate sales, it helps ecommerce brands manage the full creator collaboration process—from finding the right people to receiving content and measuring results.

Can I cancel my subscription at any time?

Yes. You can cancel your subscription from your account settings. Your access and any applicable billing conditions will follow the terms of your selected plan.
